title: Promotion expiry contract
text: Checkout promotions remain valid when now <= expiresAt. A 20 percent promotion on subtotal 10000 yields total 8000. Times use UTC millisecond precision.

title: Inventory reservation contention / requirements
text: Inventory reservations must never oversell. With one item and two concurrent distinct requests, exactly one succeeds and one returns 409. Retrying the same idempotency key returns the original reservation.

title: Tenant cache isolation / requirements
text: Every profile read must be tenant isolated. Identical userId values across tenants must never share displayName, permissions or cached profile objects.
